headlines.description: — Paul Skenes won his second straight start after going winless for nine in a row as the Pittsburgh Pirates scored 10 runs in the fourth inning to rout the Milwaukee Brewers 14-5 Sunday and head into the All-Star break with a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Skenes wins 2nd straight start after 9-game winless slide, Pirates rout Brewers 14-5 with 10-run 4th

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Leody Taveras homered and drove in three runs, Samuel Basallo added a solo shot and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Kansas City Royals 8-2 Sunday for a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taveras' homer and 3 RBIs carry the Orioles to an 8-2 win over the Royals for a 3-game sweep

events.name: New York Yankees at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Ben Rice hit a two-run triple in the top of the eighth inning to give the New York Yankees their third straight come-from-behind victory over the Washington Nationals, 5-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yankees win 5-3, sweep 3 games from the Nationals despite trailing after 7 innings in each

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Francisco Lindor misplayed a potential game-ending, double-play grounder for an error that led to Boston's two-run ninth inning, Anthony Siegler hit a sacrifice fly in the 10th and the Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine by beating the New...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lindor error leads to Red Sox comeback in 3-2, 10-inning win over Mets as Boston completes 9-0 trip

headlines.description: — Alex Bregman had a season-high four RBI, including a three-run homer in a four-run seventh inning, and the Chicago Cubs beat the Cincinnati Reds 8-4 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bregman's season-high 4 RBIs lead Cubs over Reds 8-4 heading into break

headlines.description: — Joey Cantillo struck out nine over five innings of one-run ball, Brayan Rocchio homered and drove in two and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Miami Marlins 5-2 on Sunday to complete a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cantillo strikes out 9, Rocchio and DeLauter homer as Guardians beat Marlins to sweep series

headlines.description: — J.T. Realmuto hit a three-run double in the sixth inning and Zack Wheeler struck out 10 in six scoreless innings, helping the
headlines.shortLinkText: Realmuto's 3-run double and Wheeler's strong pitching help Phillies beat Tigers 5-0 to win series

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Randy Arozarena hit a three-run homer after Seattle lost starting pitcher Emerson Hancock to a hand injury in the second inning, and the Mariners beat the Tampa Bay Rays 8-2 on Sunday to snap a five-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners lose starter Hancock to a hand injury but beat Rays 8-2 to snap a five-game losing streak

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Trevor Larnach homered and drove in two runs, Ryan Jeffers added a two-run double and the Minnesota Twins beat the Los Angeles Angels 4-2 Sunday and have won eight of their last nine series heading into the All-Star break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Twins beat Angels 4-2 and head into break winning 8 of their last 9 series

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Sam Antonacci and Braden Montgomery homered in a six-run first inning and the White Sox extended the Athletics' losing streak to nine with a 9-1 victory on Sunday that left Chicago atop the AL Central entering the All-Stark break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montgomery has career-high 4 RBIs in 9-1 win, White Sox extend A's losing streak to 9

events.name: Atlanta Braves at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Ozzie Albies doubled and scored the winning run on Masyn Winn’s throwing error in the ninth inning, allowing the Atlanta Braves to avoid a sweep against the St. Louis Cardinals with a 4-3 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves rally in 9th for 4-3 victory over Cardinals

headlines.description: — Brandon Nimmo hit a game-ending single that drove in Wyatt Langford with his third hit of the game, and the Texas Rangers beat the Houston Astros 6-5 on Sunday to enter the All-Star break with a winning record at 49-47.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nimmo's walk-off single gives Rangers 6-5 win over Astros and winning record at All-Star break

events.name: Colorado Rockies at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers scored the tiebreaking run in a two-run eighth inning when catcher Hunter Goodman threw wildly into center field on a stolen-base attempt, and the San Francisco Giants overcame Jake McCarthy's second leadoff inside-the-park home run...
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants overcome McCarthy's 2nd inside-the-park homer this year, beat Rockies 3-1

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Ildemaro Vargas had two hits, including a go-ahead single in the sixth inning, and the Arizona Diamondbacks overcame Shohei Ohtani's 22nd home run in a 5-3 victory over the sloppy Los Angeles Dodgers on Sunday that finished a three-game sweep...
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks overcome Ohtani's 22nd homer, beat sloppy Dodgers 5-3 for 3-game sweep

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Manny Machado singled in the tying run in the eighth inning and Ty France's sacrifice brought in the go-ahead run for the San Diego Padres, who beat the Toronto Blue Jays 5-4 on Sunday to take two of three.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado leads rally that carries Padres past Blue Jays 5-4
